summary: E2E validation of (1) alignment fix in Employee form and (2) new end_date pro-rata feature. Bug fix confirmed visually — hire/seniority and birth/age pairs sit on the same grid rows. end_date pro-rata works correctly end-to-end: backend returns proration_factor=0.5, months_active=6, monthly=[13k,12k,13k,13k,12k,13k,0,0,0,0,0,0], total_budgeted=79 657 $ ≈ 50% of 159 314 $ full year. Budget table row displays 'PRO-RATA 6 MOIS' badge. BudgetFicheDialog shows correct monthly ventilation (JAN..JUIN > 0, JUIL..DEC = 0 $) and total 79 657 $. Cleanup done.

issues: For an employee prorated because of end_date (not hire_date), the header still displays 'Embauche en cours d'année → pro-rata dès le mois 1 (6 mois)'. Wording is misleading: should say 'Fin d'emploi en cours d'année → actif jusqu'au mois X (N mois)' when only end_date triggers proration. See BudgetFicheDialog around the section displaying `p.hire_month` and `months_active`.

action_items: Optional: refine BudgetFicheDialog ventilation header label to distinguish between mid-year hire vs mid-year end_date (currently only mentions 'Embauche en cours d'année').

Note for QA: creating an employee via the UI requires filling 'Titre / Poste' (f-title), 'Jours maladie / perso' (f-sick) and 'Jours fériés' (f-holiday) — these are validated as required by EmpForm. The original test spec omitted them; the form correctly refused save with toast 'Veuillez corriger les champs obligatoires'. Not a bug; only a testing-spec caveat.
critical_code_review_comments: Employes.js EmpForm has no default for sick_personal_days / holiday_days (both '' in `empty`) yet marks them required in validation. Consider seeding them to 0 or 'N/A' to reduce friction, OR making them optional in the schema.
BudgetFicheDialog header string 'Embauche en cours d'année → pro-rata dès le mois {hire_month}' is used for any prorated line, even when the cause is end_date. Distinguish the two cases.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (with API-created seed employee due to unrelated required-field omissions in the test spec)

seed_data_creation: Created employee 'QA Fin Test' (#365) via backend API with end_date=2026-06-30 to exercise the ventilation UI, then deleted it via the UI at the end. Environment left in original state (122 employees).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employees testids on rows: delete-employee-{n}, edit-employee-{n}. Budget row edit btn: edit-line-{n} (NOT budget-edit-*). Search input on budget page: budget-table-search. Search input on employees page: employee-search. Delete confirmation: delete-confirm-btn. Employee form requires: name, department, title, current_annual_salary>0, vacation_rate_pct, sick_personal_days, holiday_days, hire_date, birth_date (see Employes.js:56-66). Vacation is stored as decimal (0.08 for 8%); frontend divides pct by 100 before POST.
